meta.title: Country Conditions
meta.source: World Bank, World Development Indicators and Worldwide Governance Indicators

fdi.name: Foreign direct investment, net inflows (% of GDP)
fdi.note: Net inflows of foreign direct investment.

trade_open.name: Trade (% of GDP)
trade_open.note: Exports plus imports of goods and services.

current_acct.name: Current account balance (% of GDP)
current_acct.note: Positive values are surpluses, negative values deficits.

unemployment.name: Unemployment, total (% of total labor force) (modeled ILO estimate)
unemployment.organization: ILO Modelled Estimates database (ILOEST), International Labour Organization (ILO), uri: https://ilostat.ilo.org/data/bulk/, publisher: ILOSTAT, type: external database, date accessed: January 17, 2026

gini.name: Gini index
gini.note: 0 is perfect equality, 100 perfect inequality. Measured in survey years only.
gini.organization: World Bank, Poverty and Inequality Platform. Data are based on primary household survey data obtained from government statistical agencies and World Bank country departments. Data for high-income economies are mostly from the Luxembourg Income Study database. For more information and methodology, please see http://pip.worldbank.org., World Bank (WB), uri: http://pip.worldbank.org, note: Data are based on primary household survey data obtained from government statistical agencies and World Bank country departments. Data for high-income economies are mostly from the Luxembourg Income Study database.

remittances.name: Personal remittances, received (% of GDP)
remittances.note: Personal transfers and compensation of employees received.

life_exp.name: Life expectancy at birth, total (years)

under5.name: Mortality rate, under-5 (per 1,000 live births)
under5.note: Deaths before age 5 per 1,000 live births.

health_spend.name: Current health expenditure (% of GDP)
health_spend.organization: Global Health Expenditure Database, updated December 12th, 2025, World Health Organization (WHO), uri: https://apps.who.int/nha/database

co2.name: Carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions excluding LULUCF per capita (t CO2e/capita)
co2.note: Carbon dioxide emissions per person, excluding land use change.
co2.organization:
EDGAR (Emissions Database for Global Atmospheric Research) Community GHG Database, Joint Research Centre (JRC) - European Commission, uri: https://edgar.jrc.ec.europa.eu/dataset_ghg2024, publisher: JRC European Commission, date published: 2024;
International Energy Agency (IEA), uri: https://edgar.jrc.ec.europa.eu/dataset_ghg2024, publisher: JRC European Commission, date published: 2024

renewables.name: Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption)
renewables.note: Renewable share of total final energy consumption. Includes traditional biomass.
renewables.organization: IEA Energy Statistics Data Browser, International Energy Agency (IEA), uri: https://www.iea.org/data-and-statistics/data-tools/energy-statistics-data-browser, publisher: International Energy Agency (IEA), date accessed: 2025-03-25

pm25.name: PM2.5 air pollution, mean annual exposure (micrograms per cubic meter)
pm25.note: Mean annual exposure to fine particulate matter.
pm25.organization: Global Burden of Disease Study 2023 (GBD 2023) Air Pollution Exposure Estimates and Risk Curves 1990-2023, GBD Collaborator Network, uri: https://ghdx.healthdata.org/record/ihme-data/gbd-2023-air-pollution-exposure-estimates-1990-2023, note: Need to create account to retrieve data., publisher: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation (IHME), date accessed: 2026-04-03, date published: 2026-01-23
